answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow effectively stops Sybil attacks. First, each agent must lock high-value collateral in a smart contract. Second, peer nodes audit every single transaction to ensure total validity. Third, any detected malicious activity triggers an immediate, permanent loss of the entire stake. An attacker incurs a cost of $45,000 in bonds and 30 days of verification per fake identity. This mechanism acts as a heavy anchor for honesty, preventing a comet of fraudulent nodes from striking. Like a dark onyx wall, the escrow stands firm against a swarm.
